No actionable comments were generated in the recent review. 🎉
ℹ️ Recent review info
⚙️ Run configuration **Configuration used**: defaults **Review profile**: CHILL **Plan**: Pro **Run ID**: `424735c7-cdbc-43f9-9f7a-ab916ca46a4f`
📥 Commits Reviewing files that changed from the base of the PR and between 4f78aed943e3cb57785d9887bb7034c8d6287854 and d48fda23655b8d8d5b9912620fe7147b74722b57.
⛔ Files ignored due to path filters (1) * `Cargo.lock` is excluded by `!**/*.lock`
📒 Files selected for processing (5) * `smolmix/core/Cargo.toml` * `wasm/smolmix/src/dns.rs` * `wasm/smolmix/src/fetch.rs` * `wasm/smolmix/src/stream.rs` * `wasm/smolmix/src/tunnel.rs`
---
📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This PR introduces a complete browser-native WASM networking stack (`wasm/smolmix`) that routes HTTP, WebSocket, and DNS traffic through the Nym mixnet, while refactoring existing crates to use optional feature flags for codec and heavy dependencies. It updates workspace-wide dependency declarations to explicitly enable default features. ## Changes **Feature gating refactoring in existing crates** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**IP packet requests codec feature gating**
`common/ip-packet-requests/Cargo.toml`, `common/ip-packet-requests/src/codec.rs`, `common/ip-packet-requests/src/response_helpers.rs`|Adds an optional `codec` feature that gates the tokio-util dependency, introduces a standalone `decode_one` method for packet decoding, and makes the Encoder/Decoder trait implementations conditional on the feature.| |**Nym LP full feature structure**
`common/nym-lp/Cargo.toml`, `common/nym-lp/src/lib.rs`, `common/nym-lp/src/packet/mod.rs`|Restructures dependencies into light (always-on) and heavy (optional) categories, introduces a `full` feature that enables heavy dependencies, and gates heavy modules and re-exports behind the `full` feature in both manifest and source.| |**Workspace dependency configuration updates**
`Cargo.toml`, `common/nym-connection-monitor/Cargo.toml`, `common/registration/Cargo.toml`, `nym-gateway-probe/Cargo.toml`, `nym-ip-packet-client/Cargo.toml`, `nym-node/Cargo.toml`, `sdk/rust/nym-sdk/Cargo.toml`, `service-providers/ip-packet-router/Cargo.toml`, `smolmix/core/Cargo.toml`|Root `Cargo.toml` adds WASM member and new workspace dependencies for WASM-specific protocols (`async-tungstenite`, `futures-rustls`, `httparse`, rustls crypto crates, `getrandom04`), adjusts feature flags (`default-features = false` on `hyper`), and adds release profile optimization. All package consumers explicitly set `default-features = true` on `nym-ip-packet-requests` and `nym-lp`.| **WASM smolmix networking implementation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**WASM crate configuration and build setup**
`wasm/smolmix/Cargo.toml`, `wasm/smolmix/.cargo/config.toml`, `wasm/smolmix/.gitignore`, `wasm/smolmix/Makefile`, `wasm/smolmix/README.md`|Adds Cargo manifest with WASM-specific dependencies (HTTP/DNS/WebSocket clients, smoltcp, rustls with RustCrypto), target configuration for `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, release profile optimization, Makefile with build targets and test automation, and comprehensive README with architecture diagrams.| |**Core types, configuration, and error handling**
`wasm/smolmix/src/lib.rs`, `wasm/smolmix/src/error.rs`|Defines public API types (`SetupOpts`, `TunnelOpts`, `SurbsConfig`, `FetchError`, `HttpResponse`) with automatic error conversion and WASM error registration; implements tunnel lifecycle management via `setupMixTunnel`/`disconnectMixTunnel`.| |**Utilities for logging and formatting**
`wasm/smolmix/src/util.rs`|Provides `hex_preview` for binary data formatting and feature-gated `debug_log!`/`debug_error!` macros for conditional console output when the `debug` feature is enabled.| |**Network stack foundations**
`wasm/smolmix/src/device.rs`, `wasm/smolmix/src/reactor.rs`, `wasm/smolmix/src/stream.rs`|Implements synchronous `smoltcp::Device` with in-memory packet queues, adaptive reactor polling with notifications, and `futures::io` adapters (`WasmTcpStream`, `WasmUdpSocket`, `PooledConn`) for async TCP/UDP with ephemeral port allocation and reactor wake-up signaling.| |**Protocol layers**
`wasm/smolmix/src/ipr.rs`, `wasm/smolmix/src/dns.rs`, `wasm/smolmix/src/http.rs`, `wasm/smolmix/src/tls.rs`|Implements IPR protocol with connect handshake and packet encapsulation, DNS A/AAAA/CNAME resolution with per-session caching, hyper-based HTTP/1.1 client with stream adaptation, and futures-rustls TLS connector with RustCrypto crypto provider and cipher suite filtering.| |**Tunnel orchestration and packet bridge**
`wasm/smolmix/src/tunnel.rs`, `wasm/smolmix/src/bridge.rs`|Orchestrates tunnel startup via Nym base client initialization, IPR handshake, and smoltcp stack configuration. Implements packet bridge that relays incoming reconstructed messages to smoltcp RX queue and drains outgoing packets to mixnet via IPR.| |**Fetch orchestrator**
`wasm/smolmix/src/fetch.rs`|Implements main `fetch` entrypoint with DNS resolution, TCP/TLS connection, HTTP execution, per-origin connection pooling, redirect following with scheme/origin restrictions, and response serialization to JavaScript.| |**JavaScript WASM entry points**
`wasm/smolmix/src/mixfetch.rs`, `wasm/smolmix/src/mixdns.rs`, `wasm/smolmix/src/mixsocket.rs`|Exports core WASM functions to JavaScript: `setupMixTunnel`/`disconnectMixTunnel`, `mixFetch`, `mixResolve`, and `mixSocket`/`wsSend`/`wsClose` using global `TUNNEL` singleton for state persistence.| |**Development and testing infrastructure**
`wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/bootstrap.js`, `wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/headless-bootstrap.js`, `wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/headless.html`, `wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/headless.js`, `wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/index.html`, `wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/index.js`, `wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/mix-socket.js`, `wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/package.json`, `wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/webpack.config.js`, `wasm/smolmix/internal-dev/worker.js`|Provides Webpack-based development harness with interactive and headless test pages, Web Worker isolation, Comlink IPC bridges, MixSocket JavaScript class as WebSocket drop-in replacement, and comprehensive testing UI for HTTPS, DNS, WebSocket, stress tests, and file operations.| |**Playwright automated test suite**
`wasm/smolmix/tests/.gitignore`, `wasm/smolmix/tests/README.md`, `wasm/smolmix/tests/package.json`, `wasm/smolmix/tests/playwright.config.mjs`, `wasm/smolmix/tests/tests/smoke.spec.mjs`, `wasm/smolmix/tests/tests/suite.spec.mjs`|Implements end-to-end tests via Playwright with smoke tests for tunnel setup, suite tests for HTTP/DNS/WebSocket/stress under multiple traffic configurations, and browser-specific configuration and workarounds for Chromium/Firefox/WebKit.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 5 (Critical) | ⏱️ ~120 minutes ## Poem > 🐰 In wasm I burrow, packets in my paw, > I stitch DNS, TLS, and webs with a law. > Smoltcp hums softly while the reactor sings, > Mixnet tunnels whisper and the WebSocket springs. > Tests hop in line — hooray! the network claps its paws.
✨ Finishing Touches
📝 Generate docstrings - [ ] Create stacked PR - [ ] Commit on current branch
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests - [ ] Commit unit tests in branch `max/smolmix-wasm`
⚔️ Resolve merge conflicts - [ ] Resolve merge conflict in branch `max/smolmix-wasm`

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
